name: Ashton Starr
text:
I got my Ragdoll kitten from Kitten Around Ragdolls in July 2025, and the entire process was wonderful. Since I’m on the East Coast, Kiki went out of her way to FaceTime with me, talk me through the process, and answer all my questions. She was incredibly responsive and made me feel confident every step of the way.


        My kitten — known as Bedtime Bear but now named Chloe — is the sweetest, most playful little girl. I honestly couldn’t imagine life without her! Everyone who meets her falls in love instantly, and I credit so much of that to the care and dedication Kiki puts into raising her kittens. They are clearly well-socialized, happy, and raised with so much love.
        
      
        I would absolutely get another Ragdoll from Kiki in a heartbeat. Hopefully in the next year or two, Chloe will have a sibling from her. Kiki would be the first breeder I go to, and I highly recommend her to anyone looking for a Ragdoll.

name: Veronica
text: We adopted our little girl Charly last year (she just turned 1!!). Kiki was great to work with and answered all of our questions about the kitties. I’m a newer cat mom so she has been a great resource for me when I have any concerns about our kitties health. You can tell she really loves and cares about her cats. Oh, and let’s not fail to mention that these kitties are beautiful too! I love how she posts lots of pictures and videos on social media so we could watch them grow and get a glimpse of their personalities. Charly is a laid back cat that just loves to be loved. I would absolutely recommend adopt from her.

name: Kirsten Mead
text: We recently adopted our second Ragdoll from Kitten Around Ragdolls, and they are the best cats! People are always commenting on how beautiful the cats are, and both are friendly and get along with everyone. The adoption process was painless both times. Kiki was really helpful in answering our questions and finding the right cats for us based on their personalities. She also sent the kittens home with goody bags full of cat toys and treats, which was a nice touch.

name: Kim Borges
text: I adopted my Ragdoll kitten Lily (Hello Kitty) from Kitten Around Ragdolls in July and she has been the best kitty!! You can tell she was raised in a loving family environment with people, dogs and friendly kitties. It was a wonderful experience adopting from them from the start and I highly recommend Kitten Around if you are looking for a Ragdoll…they are truly the best cats!

name: Dina Blake
text:
I have wanted a Ragdoll for years, after being owned by a couple of Maine Coons. I wanted a local breeder with a good reputation for healthy kittens. My research brought me to Kiki at Kitten Around Ragdolls. As soon as we saw mom and dad and the kittens, I knew this was where I was getting my fur baby! The cats are gorgeous, of course. But they are also healthy, well-loved and incredibly well socialized. The kittens are raised with Australian Shepherds - and that clinched it. I have one too.
    Kai has been the best thing that’s happened to our little family. He’s a huge, fluffy, adorable, silky, 15lb. floof of love. I’d get 5 more from Kiki if I could. Go see her kittens - you go home with at least one!
